Profile Damiana is the dried leaves and stem of Turnera diffusa var. aph- rodisiaca (Turneraceae) and possibly other species of Turnera. Damiana is drunk as a tea, and is used in herbal medicine for a variety of indications. It has a reputation as an aphrodisiac, but there is no evidence for this. Homoeopathy. Damiana has been used in homoeopathic med- icines under the following names: Turnera diffusa.
